books.title: Anne of Green Gables
books.author: L.M. Montgomery
books.description: Orphan Anne Shirley arrives with an imagination large enough for Avonlea — and a red-haired insistence that beauty belongs everywhere.
books.quotesJson: ["Dear old world, you are very lovely, and I am glad to be alive in you.","Kindred spirits are not so scarce as I used to think."]
books.reflectionsJson: ["What place first felt like home because of imagination?","Who is your kindred spirit?"]

books.title: The Secret Garden
books.author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
books.description: A neglected garden awakens with a lonely girl, a boy who speaks to earth, and the quiet miracle of tending what was forgotten.
books.quotesJson: ["If you look the right way, you can see that the whole world is a garden.","Where you tend a rose, my lad, a thistle cannot grow."]
books.reflectionsJson: ["What neglected corner of your life could use a little care?","Who helped you rediscover wonder?"]

books.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
books.author: Lewis Carroll
books.description: A curious tumble down the rabbit hole into riddles, tea, and impossible manners.
